Use this exemplar to start a preregistered report or replication study in a
standalone repository.

1. Fork this repository, or use the copier from the
   [template monorepo](https://github.com/docxology/template).
   Run `uv run python scripts/audit/copy_exemplar.py --source templates/template_registered_report --dest <destination> --new-name <project_slug>`
   from the monorepo root when that exemplar is present there.
2. Replace the [example registration](../data/example_registration.json).
   Record the registered-report stage, ethics-review status, and planned
   sensitivity analyses.
3. Update the [manuscript config](manuscript/config.yaml) using the
   [fork defaults](manuscript/config.yaml.example), along with the
   [domain profile](../domain_profile.yaml) and [experiment plan](../experiment_plan.yaml).
4. Run the [tests](README.md#setup-and-tests) and regenerate the
   [review artifacts](rendering.md#regenerate-the-evidence) before interpreting results.

Label exploratory analyses explicitly and link them to the deviation ledger.
